description: FINDING 2026-08-11, from implementing the analytic ZBS closure (op-jyyp.3). The 18-point pebble-bed effective-conductivity tabulation in reference-data/virtual_test_bed/htgr/generic-pbr/pbr.i block keff_pebble_bed (300-2000 K, 11.94-44.95 W/(m K)) -- transcribed as the reference table in crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/zbs.rs and named the acceptance target for the analytic ZBS -- CANNOT be produced by the Zehner-Bauer-Schlunder correlation with the deck's own stated inputs (eps=0.39, d_pebble=0.06 m, emissivity=0.8, graphite k_s=26 W/(m K), helium at 6 MPa). Evidence, all computed 2026-08-11: (1) full ZBS (van Antwerpen 2010 form, contact phi=0.0077, C=1.25) with helium k_f from the KTA 3102.1 correlation gives 2.08 W/(m K) at 300 K vs the table's 11.94 (-83%), 10.5 vs 27.3 at 1000 K, 29.0 vs 45.0 at 2000 K; (2) inverting for the fluid conductivity the table would require gives k_f = 3.8 W/(m K) at 300 K rising past 40 at 1300 K -- no gas has this; (3) physically, stagnant-helium graphite pebble-bed effective conductivity at ambient is order 1-2 W/(m K) (SANA/HTTU-class experiments), so 11.94 at 300 K is not a physical stagnant-bed value under any correlation. The generating configuration is unknown -- SAM is closed-source, and the ANL reports (ANL/NSE-19/46, the NT24-115 SAM thermal-fluids paper, ANL pebble-temperature paper) cite the ZBS model but do not print the evaluation that produced this table. The analytic ZBS in crates/tampines/src/pebble_bed/zbs.rs carries a documented-discrepancy test recording the full 18-point comparison. CONSEQUENCE: the zbs.rs module doc in the digital-twin-engine frames this table as 'the published reference an analytic ZBS implementation must reproduce' -- that framing needs revisiting by the maintainer (that crate is owned by another agent; not edited). The table remains a faithful transcription of what the VTB/SAM model USED; the question is whether it is what ZBS PRODUCES. Options: keep the table as the interim bed conductivity (it is what the VTB transient models ran with), use the analytic ZBS, or obtain the full NEA PBMR-400 spec / SAM documentation to resolve the generating inputs.
title: VTB generic-pbr ZBS 18-point k_eff table cannot be reproduced by the ZBS correlation with helium -- reference data suspect
